description: The public sandbox's one action (ADR-0014). Releases sandbox:receipt to the sandbox receipt endpoint, which acts on nothing and answers with a receipt, only with a signed approval for the target. In the sandbox anyone can get that approval from POST /sandbox/approvals. A note longer than 200 characters is refused.

outcome.reason: The note is longer than 200 characters.
A receipt needs a signed approval for this target in signals.approvalArtifact, with receiptApproved true. In the sandbox, get one from POST /sandbox/approvals.
